title: Filing: AMD will pay ~$2.9B in cash and stock for AI chip startup Taalas, with $1.4B dependent on unspecified conditions; the deal was announced in August (Murad Hemmadi/Globe and Mail)
summary: Murad Hemmadi / Globe and Mail: Filing: AMD will pay ~$2.9B in cash and stock for AI chip startup Taalas, with $1.4B dependent on unspecified conditions; the deal was announced in August — Advanced Micro Devices Inc. AMD-Q said Wednesday that it will pay about US$2.9-billion for Toronto-based semiconductor startup Taalas Inc. …
